settings.title: Settings
settings.nextLife: These choices apply to your next life.
settings.nextLifeKeep: These choices apply to your next life. The life you are living now keeps its own.
settings.modeBirthNow: Odds of a baby being born in each country today.
settings.modePopNow: Odds by everyone alive today, all 8 billion.
settings.modeBirthPast: Odds by where babies were born that year.
settings.modePopPast: Odds by everyone alive that year.
settings.hintNow: Live a whole life in today’s world. Today’s statistics hold to the end.
settings.hintPast: Be born in a past year and live through the history that really followed. Past lives use historical UN data for that year; from today on, they follow projections.
settings.hintFuture: Be born now and live into the world to come. Future lives follow UN projections plus the odds history has shown. One possibility, not a fixed future.
settings.hintAny: One of the three is drawn: the past, today or the future. If the past comes up, the year of birth is drawn too.
settings.yearHintAny: The year is drawn too: the more babies were born in a year, the likelier it is.
settings.yearHintPick: Your next life starts in {year}, with that year’s historical data.
settings.paceNote: Minutes of real time for a life as long as the life expectancy, at speed ×1. The game keeps every year at least 12 seconds, so at 10 min most lives take 12–17 min.
